cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: For the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to state exactly what they did, knew, or authorized before you reveal your own involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before I show you my dinner invitations, who did you authorize your sister to bring?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A date. Did you invite my ex?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Did you name anyone she couldn't bring? Then we'll get to my list.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. My ex. I sent you both the same message.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What time did you send it to me? I'll put that beside my invitation's timestamp before we open it.

mechanism: A coaches its former hosting pupil exact guest permissions and notification timing before exposing its own invitation list.
confusable: Not freely explaining a misunderstanding: A repeatedly delays its disclosure until B supplies a precise account first.
comparison: Purchase scope and date versus social exclusion and message timestamp.
